metric_defs.comparisons: identical both modes (same linear-merge work) -> same total work, pure scheduling effect
metric_defs.merge_ms: SUMMED across 4 workers (thread-CPU time); utilization=merge_ms/wall; >1 = overlap proof, not a bug
metric_defs.rss: noise-level both (+-6MB); contention none (bounded qmax=8 never blocks measurably)

overall.correct: exact vs np.unique+bincount ref, all 16 cells both modes
overall.overlap: dynamic overlaps levels (parent fires on counter, no round barrier); static serializes rounds
overall.winner: DYNAMIC at depth>=3 (cross-level overlap); STATIC at depth 1 (no scheduling overhead). No Planner integration (research-only per protocol).
